exposure: Clinical risk factors for CMT (developmental dysplasia of the hip, plagiocephaly, mode of birth)
outcome: Cervical range of motion improvement (lateral flexion, axial rotation)
cohort: The study included 171 patients diagnosed with congenital muscular torticollis at a single institution between January 1, 2016, and July 31, 2023.
finding: Most infants with CMT who are otherwise healthy improve rapidly without surgery, and for those requiring longer treatment or surgical intervention, outcomes are favorable.
